themes.title: Far-right parties push anti-immigration policies amid border crises
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are intensifying anti-immigration rhetoric and policies in response to perceived border crises. This theme is evident in Spain's Vox party blaming the government for migration surges, Italy's Lega and Fratelli d'Italia demanding stricter controls, and the U.S. Trump administration's mass visa revocations targeting asylum seekers. The convergence reflects a shared framing of immigration as an existential threat requiring urgent, draconian measures.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands prosecution of Spanish government for 'treason' over Ceuta migration crisis, accusing Morocco of 'hybrid warfare' and calling for border closures.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Salvini and Meloni push for stricter immigration controls, with Salvini proposing bank taxes to fund long-term fuel subsidies and criticizing NGOs for aiding migrants.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration announces plans to revoke up to 200,000 visas of asylum seekers, pauses global visa appointments, and threatens to demolish the Kennedy Center over immigration-related disputes.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage exposes Channel migrant crossings, accusing UK and French governments of collusion, and proposes prioritizing married couples for social housing.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Calls for stricter immigration policies, including banning hawala money transfers and deporting foreign criminals.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen leads polls with anti-immigration platform, criticizing Macron's policies and advocating for 'national priority' in welfare and jobs.

signals: shared framing of migration as existential threat

themes.title: Right-wing leaders seek re-election amid economic controversies
themes.blurb: Right-wing leaders in Argentina, Poland, and Hungary are navigating re-election campaigns while facing economic backlash. Javier Milei's austerity measures have sparked public discontent despite inflation control, while Poland's PiS and Hungary's Fidesz/Tisza grapple with internal divisions and voter dissatisfaction over economic policies. The theme highlights parallel struggles to balance ideological commitments with electoral pragmatism.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei faces growing discontent over austerity measures, with polls showing declining approval despite inflation control. Government denies economic crisis while preparing for 2027 re-election.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS faces internal divisions and declining polls, with Morawiecki launching a rival party (Rozwój Plus) and Kaczyński struggling to maintain unity ahead of elections.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Tisza government implements austerity measures despite pre-election promises, facing criticism over budget cuts and economic mismanagement.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump's economic policies, including tariffs and beef import plans, face backlash from farmers and ranchers, complicating his re-election narrative.

themes.title: Internal divisions challenge right-wing party unity
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in Italy, Poland, and the UK are grappling with internal fractures that threaten their electoral prospects. Italy's Lega faces leadership tensions between Salvini and regional governors, Poland's PiS is splintering with Morawiecki's defection, and Reform UK struggles with candidate controversies. These divisions reflect broader transnational patterns of ideological fragmentation within right-wing movements.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Salvini faces internal rebellion from regional governors like Fontana and Zaia, with tensions over leadership and policy direction ahead of elections.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS fractures as Morawiecki launches Rozwój Plus, challenging Kaczyński's leadership and creating a rival right-wing faction.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Faces candidate controversies, including a councillor's suspension over historical social media posts and internal disputes over strategy.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Internal conflicts emerge between Milei's faction and local leaders like Olmedo and Orozco in Salta, challenging national strategy.

themes.title: Far-right parties gain ground in regional and national polls
themes.blurb: Far-right parties are making significant electoral gains across Europe, with Germany's AfD leading in Saxony-Anhalt polls, Sweden Democrats narrowing the gap in Sweden, and France's Rassemblement National dominating presidential polls. This transnational surge reflects growing voter dissatisfaction with mainstream parties and a shift toward nationalist, anti-establishment platforms.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD leads polls in Saxony-Anhalt with 43%, potentially securing an absolute majority and making Ulrich Siegmund Germany's first far-right state premier.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Gains support in polls, narrowing the right-wing bloc's lead over the opposition to 6.8%, while pushing for stricter immigration and housing policies.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen leads 2027 presidential polls with 35-38%, positioning her as the frontrunner against leftist rivals like Mélenchon.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Leads polls at 24%, surpassing Conservatives, with Nigel Farage's influence growing amid internal Tory struggles.

themes.title: Right-wing governments target social programs amid fiscal debates
themes.blurb: Right-wing governments in Argentina, Hungary, and the UK are implementing or proposing cuts to social programs as part of broader fiscal consolidation efforts. Milei's administration refuses aid to indebted families, Hungary's Tisza government faces backlash over austerity measures, and Reform UK proposes housing policy changes that critics argue could harm vulnerable groups. These parallel developments reflect a shared ideological commitment to reducing state welfare spending.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Government refuses aid to 5.86 million indebted families, calling debt a 'private issue' despite rising default rates.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Tisza government implements austerity measures, including budget cuts and reduced social spending, despite pre-election promises.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Proposes prioritizing married couples with children for social housing, raising concerns from domestic abuse charities about victims staying with abusers.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Proposes changes to Medicare and Social Security, including ending Medicare Part D in 2027, sparking concerns about healthcare access.

signals: ideological commitment to reduced state spending
